philology_and_source_scope.original_phrase: 立成傳寫魯魚，不得其説，不敢妄用
philology_and_source_scope.interpretation: The Qing-era biographical tradition describes concern about scribal/printed corruption of li-cheng material and cautions against uncritical use. The statement is a biography narrator’s characterization, not a verified first-person Mei diary/preface quote.
philology_and_source_scope.lu_yu: 魯魚 is a conventional metonym for graphic confusion / textual copying errors; it is not a named L132 numeral, unit, column, or numerical correction.
philology_and_source_scope.temporal_layer: Ruan Yuan attributed biography and later Qing/republican editorial transmission postdate Yuan Shoushi and Ming Xu-An/Sun-Wei printing. The original creation date of an underlying defect and the date of an observed copy remain unproven.
philology_and_source_scope.scope_limit: The text does not locate 《授時曆立成》 GK00893_00, Xing 《古今律曆考》 juan45 table B, Xu-An NLC08938 L132, specific 一七五二/三 glyph, 疾捷法, 少/微 radix, or crosswork same-field alignment.
philology_and_source_scope.no_numerical_inference: General historical awareness of corrupt tables cannot award or disqualify any one historic numeric value, cannot establish one Xu-An variant as erroneous, and cannot validate a modern reconstruction.

access_and_independence.digital_reading_methods: Website text/snippets only; no OCR run in this session, no native printed page/source pixel hashing.

A modern SSID volume-6 PDF around 591 remained screenshot-inaccessible due to 17.9MB source-size limit; its earlier suspicious 1221萬 extraction therefore remains quarantined separately as in 13WY.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: The Qing biography’s generic copying-corruption statement does not identify which extant Yuan/Ming/Qing table impression or glyph is corrupt.
Shidian, CText, and a later Qingshigao biography rendering cannot be counted as three independently dated ancient Shoushi original witnesses.
unresolved_lineage_questions: What dated edition and underlying document informed Ruan Yuan’s specific description of li-cheng copying errors?
Can independently authenticated Xu-An juan45 L132 original strokes or a source-native 疾-specific coefficient constructor and 少/微 radix rules be read?
